cause: Optional thumbnail descriptor is truthy even when its authorized grant is explicitly empty; it showed a misleading No attachment label above a valid primary image.
change: Hide only the optional thumbnail with status empty; preserve loading, missing, pending and unavailable states. Primary attachment logic unchanged.

visual_review.observations: Single primary media card; no misleading empty-thumbnail label. Open/Download actions fit, controls have readable spacing, no clipping. Fixture image decoded; not production image-content proof.

scope: Local UI and clean build only; parent owns actual affected Safari acceptance.

independent_review.scope: Exact empty-only condition preserves missing/pending/loading and primary attachment; four actual component cases reviewed. No authority expansion.
